verdict.rationale: Fin is an AI customer-service SaaS, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask, but nothing in the evidence documents a setting or policy that stops customer data from being used to train AI models. The trust page offers only generic compliance and 'within your own boundaries' language, and 'Train Fin on your knowledge' refers to grounding Fin in your content, not to an opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
